title: He Walked a Wire 1,350 Feet Above New York for 45 Minutes

scenes.text: In 1974, a man walked a wire 1,350 feet above New York.
scenes.keywords: twin towers new york skyline vintage

scenes.text: Philippe Petit rigged it secretly, overnight, between the tops of the Twin Towers.
At sunrise on August 7th, he stepped out onto it.
He stayed up there for 45 minutes.
He crossed eight times, and even lay down on the wire.
He later said he was dying of happiness. Eight crossings. 1,350 feet.

description:
On August 7, 1974, Philippe Petit walked a wire strung between the Twin Towers, 1,350 feet above the ground.
He spent about 45 minutes up there, crossing eight times.
Could you take one step out on that wire?
first_comment: He called it dying of happiness. Would you ever try even a wire two feet off the ground?
